summary: Comprehensive architectural, security, data migration, and UI/UX implementation plan for the Ekklesphere Creator Console (/console). Covers all confirmed decisions (Supabase Auth consolidation, 14-day auto-trial + 7-day expiry grace fail-closed licensing, dual pg_cron + Vercel cron usage rollups, and safe dry-run tenant-to-organization migration with Firestore lockdown), Phase 0 security remediations and Vitest coverage, Phase 1 Postgres schema and RLS policies, Phase 2 server middleware and rate-limited audited APIs, Phase 3 privacy-preserving Creator Console modules, and phased execution order.
